title: Mobilitetsmodellen: machine-learning estimators of intergenerational mobility in Sweden
description: Mobilitetsmodellen provides production-grade Python estimators for intergenerational income and rank mobility in Sweden. The framework combines classical rank-rank regressions, intergenerational income elasticities, and transition-matrix estimators with double machine learning (DoubleML) and generalised random forests under cross-fitting. Empirical-Bayes shrinkage stabilises municipality-level estimates to support an interactive mobility atlas.

creators.name: Laitinen-Fredriksson Lundstrom Imanov, Gustav Olaf Yunus
